name: filesystem-agent
description: Token-optimized filesystem agent for reading, writing, searching, and analyzing files with minimal token usage.
long_description: Gives Claude 22 file operations (read, write, search, edit, and code-structure analysis) scoped to directories you explicitly allow. Built for token efficiency: previews, chunked reads, and dry-run edits avoid dumping whole files into context. Runs entirely on your machine — no network calls, no telemetry.
